agent_explanation: Fast heavy body 1 (vx~27.7) strikes stationary light body 0 around step 26-27, imparting vx~30.64 to body 0 (steps 26->27). Body 0 then travels ~3 m in 6 steps (~0.52 m/step) and its right edge penetrates 0.25 beyond x=20 at step 33. Boundary collision/positional correction fails to stop this high-speed body despite substepping (18 substeps), so it escapes the arena.
